item.text: The cause is in the emphasis preprocessing: it masks escaped punctuation across the entire line before recognizing code spans. A backslash before a closing backtick therefore changes the masked copy used by emphasis parsing, even though the actual lexer correctly tokenizes the code span. I’m adjusting the masking pass to protect complete code spans first while keeping source offsets aligned.

Fixed the emphasis mask in [Lexer.ts](C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/codexdev_t6t3_r2/work/src/Lexer.ts): code spans are masked before escaped punctuation, so a backslash inside code no longer affects emphasis parsing outside it.
